evidence: Plaut. Most. 2.2.66: hospes; Cic. Agr. 2.80: vectīgālia; Liv. 26.24.4: gentēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The adjective: overseas guests, peoples, revenues, travel (trānsmarīna peregrīnātiō, Quint. 7.3.31).
For the adverb: to go, send or live overseas; Horace, below. Abroad without the sea is peregrē (see abroad).

phrases.latin: caelum, nōn animum mūtant, quī trāns mare currunt
phrases.english: those who rush off overseas change their sky, not their mind
